# infisical_pam_folder (Resource)

Create and manage folders in Infisical PAM. The machine identity that creates a folder becomes its admin. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder" "linux_team" {
  name        = "linux-team"
  description = "Linux fleet"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the folder, unique in the organization. Must be lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, at most 64 characters.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the folder.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the folder.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the PAM folder by its ID
terraform import infisical_pam_folder.example <folder_id>
```
